content: Yesu Hyaˈari Sara Vir Tau
Kaɗǝ ǝmudlau, ma tsu vi dlǝdlǝrǝu, ar pǝci nǝ tanggǝrma nǝ sugu, kǝ Maryamu Magǝdaliya maˈyi a nda tsamǝ huwa nyi. Ma ji nda ba ji lari kǝja nja jahǝnar tsǝka haɗǝ miya huwa nyi.
Kǝ ji sha ǝnga hwi a ndǝgya Simanu Biturusu ǝnga vanyi zǝmbǝlma kǝra Yesu wu yiwu ta. Kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “A hǝr nji dza Thlagǝ sara wu huwa nyi, kǝja naˈya sǝni vira nji fiya nyi ari mai.”
Kǝ Biturusu ǝnga vanyi zǝmbǝlma ta biya ndǝ mbar lagu ndar huwa nyi.
Gyapǝ nda mbar hwi, ama kǝ vanyi zǝmbǝlma ta ndiya Biturusu ǝnga hwi a ndar huwa nyi.
Ji nda uzhiya dzau, ju tsamǝ gwu huɗa huwa nyi, ba ji lari kar haɗǝ ndau a gwu huwa nyi, ama naji gwu huwa nyi mai.
Kǝ Simanu Biturusu ndǝra a gyiwu yukuɗǝ nyi shili a miya huwa nyi, ba ji tǝrabiya a gwu huwa nyi, ba ji gwa lari kar haɗǝ ndau a guna.
Kǝ ji ɓǝra lari zhaɓi kǝra nji mbuya bama Yesu ǝni a gwu huwa nyi pǝpǝɗau lagu batiti.
Kǝ zǝmbǝlma ta shili a miya huwa nyi a ndiya Biturusu ta maˈyi a gwu huwa nyi tsu. Ənggǝra ji gwa lari ba ji hǝnggǝri abǝr jiri nga nyi.
Baˈanǝ kabangǝkǝ nanda aˈyi nggabiya sǝra tsǝtsǝfau wu lǝkakaɗǝ abǝr kǝl Yesu hyaˈari sara vir tǝ mai.
Yesu Canǝ Nyi Kǝrnyi Anǝ Maryamu
Kǝ zǝmbǝlmaˈyar kǝ sha a ndu ki.
Maryamu nǝ nyi taˈyi a miya huwa nyi ja vǝr tiwi. Tsu ja vǝr tiwi, ba ji uzhau, ju tsamǝ gwu huɗa huwa nyi.
Maja vǝr tsamǝ, ba ji lari waladiˈyar mǝthlǝ wu kar pǝrtǝ ngganggashiu ar vira nji pina dza Yesu ar ta. Waladi pathlǝ a vǝr nggya a dar vir kǝra ja ǝnga vanyi tsu a gyar vir hiya ja.
Kǝ waladiya nyiˈyar yiwa nyi ndǝ na, “Mala, mi ngǝ ɗa gwu tiwi ya?” Əngwar ja, “A hǝnar nda Thlagǝ ɗa sara ǝnggau, ya, nayi wu sǝni vira ndǝ hǝna nyi a ndar mai.”
Ənggǝra ji kuɗǝna na abangau, ba ji shabiya dzau, ba ji lari Yesu taˈyi a ndǝna, ama naji tsamǝ ri abǝr Yesu ngǝ mai.

Kǝ Yesu yiwa nyi, ji na, “Mala, mi ngǝ ɗa gwu tiwi ya? Wa nga gu gala?” Ma ju nggani abǝr ndǝr mǝl thlǝr wu fa wu ta ngau, ǝngwar ja anǝ nyi, “Malǝmǝ, ma nagǝ ngǝ hǝr nyi sara ǝnggau, nar ɗa vira gǝ fiya nyi ari, aga ya nda hǝr nyi.”
Kǝ Yesu ngga nyi, ji na, “Maryamu.” Ji shabiya dzǝ a ndara ja, ji na ǝnga miya njir Yahudiya, “Rabwani!” (Kǝra ca ngǝ Malǝmǝ.)

Əngwar Yesu anǝ nyi, “Ga sara mba ɗa mai, ara tsu yi gǝra sha a da ara Tada kwatahǝu. Ama ga maˈyi a ndara zamǝɗaˈyar ga nda nar nda, sha nga yi a dara Dǝɗa ǝnga Dǝrhyi, ba a dǝgya Hyal ɗa ǝnga Hyalǝr hyi.”
Kǝ Maryamu Magǝdaliya maˈyi, ji nda nar nyi anǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar, “A lar yi Thlagǝu!” Kǝ ji nar nda sǝra Yesu nar nyi.
Yesu Canǝ Nyi KǝrnyiAnǝ Zǝmbǝlma Nyiˈyar

Əwagǝu pǝci tanggǝrma nǝ sugu, ar pǝci kǝra zǝmbǝlmaˈyar nǝ Yesu kaɓau ar vi zǝmǝu. Ndǝ haɗiya miya ki ara hivǝr njira nggurǝm nǝ Yahudiya. Ma tsu nda a vuna, kǝja Yesu taˈyu wu hada nda, ji na, “Jamǝkur ja nggya ǝnga hyi.”
Ayukuɗa ji nana ndǝr kau, kǝ ji canǝ nda tsa ja ǝnga thlǝrpa ja. Kǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar nyabiya dzǝ ǝnga huɗǝ pipida ara ndǝ lari Thlagǝu.
Kǝ Yesu ɓǝra na anǝ nda, “Jamǝkur ja nggya ǝnga hyi! Ənggǝr kǝra Tada sǝwa ɗa, abangau ǝnga yu sǝ hyi.”
Ənggǝra ji nana abangau, ba ji sǝna pi a nda gǝra nda, ji na, “Dlǝwara mau Mambǝl Cicau.
Kalar ndǝra hyi tǝfǝbiya nyi bikǝ nyi a tǝfǝbiya nyir nji bikǝ nyi, abangǝ tsu, kalar ndǝra hyi nggǝl ara tǝfǝbiya nyi bikǝ nyi a nggyari abangau.”
Yesu Canǝ Nyi Kǝrnyi Anǝ Toma
Toma (ndǝra nju ngga ǝnga ɓili), pathlǝ wu pama nda kumo apǝ mǝthlǝu, aˈyi ja ma Yesu shili ara zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar mai.

Kǝ alenyi zǝmbǝlmaˈyar kǝ na anǝ nyi, “A lar ˈya Thlagǝu!” Ama ǝngwar Toma anǝ nda, “Ma nayi aˈyi lari mǝcavǝɗi nǝ kusa ar tsa ja mai, ǝnga yi fuwa tsa yi a vu vira kusa ar ta mai, ǝnga yi fuwa tsa yi a vu thlǝrpa ja mai, nayi wu hǝnggǝri ǝni mai.”

Ayukuɗa sugu pathlǝ ǝtsu, zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar ɓǝra tsǝmiya dzǝ wu ki, ar pǝci kǝ Toma aˈyi ja ǝkkǝˈyi nda. Miya ki dǝdǝl nga nyi, ama kǝ Yesu shili ji sa taˈyi wu pama nda ji na, “Jamǝkur ja nggya ǝnga hyi.”
Kǝ ji na anǝ Toma, “Fǝr kuˈyir tsa gǝ ǝnggau, ga tsamiya tsa yau. Hǝr tsa gau ga fiya a vu thlǝrpa yau. Piyari tǝkǝkǝr ga ɗa ndǝra ǝnga mbǝrsa.”
Əngwar Toma anǝ nyi, “Thlagǝ ɗa ǝnga Hyal ɗa!”
Yesu shaɗǝwa nyi, “Ara gǝ lar ɗa nga gǝ hǝnggǝri ya? Njir barka ngǝ njira gǝra lar ɗa ama kǝ ndǝ hǝnggǝri ǝnga yau.”
Sǝra Ɗa Yahwana Tsǝfǝri Tsǝfǝ Kau
Yesu mǝliya sǝ dǝdǝgurˈyar pamǝpamǝ gangǝu wu liya zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar, kǝra nji aˈyi tsǝfǝri wu lǝkakaɗǝ kǝ mai.
Ama nji tsǝfǝri najakau, aga hya hǝnggǝri abǝr Yesu ngǝ Kǝrsiti, Zǝr Hyal, ǝnga tsu aga ja ɗa lagur mbǝrsa ba hya uya pi lagur thlǝmǝ nyi.
